oneSentenceConcept: The hero becomes the first chamber of a maison-index — chaptered typography and object-led reveals, not a walkable WebGL house.
heroConcept: Cinematic band as a reading chamber: overscaled stacked type, a single chapter rule that extends on entry, cool stone paper and wine-ink. Scroll advances the prologue; objects stay indexed, not immersive.
emergingSignals: Object-led discovery as a readable index, not an immersive world

visualLanguage: Cool chamber paper, chamber ink, and one wine-ink accent. Typographic rooms with tight architectural radii — maison restraint, not cream editorial or instrument-steel product chrome.
interactionLanguage: Chapter advance in the hero; framed depth-reveal on work teasers as object-as-index. Navigation remains a stable lintel. No magnetic cursor, no walkable house.
motionLanguage: One causal thread: chapter-rule extension on entry, crossfade between chambers. Subtle elsewhere. Instant hierarchy under prefers-reduced-motion.
storytellingApproach: Hero is the prologue chamber. Supporting sections inherit as quieter chapters in linear sequence. Case-study teasers stay teasers — catalog as index, not unboxing.
creativeTechnologyIdeas: CSS scroll-driven animation for a single hero chapter-rule extension

typographyDirection: Bold sans display overscaled in the cinematic band; comfortable minimal body in supporting chambers. Hierarchy-led type, not serif magazine editorial.
compositionDirection: Cinematic-band hero as the first room; supporting sections use muted bands and a comfortable grid. Asymmetry only as a human offset inside the band.
colorDirection: Cool chamber paper field, near-black ink, single wine-ink accent for chapter emphasis only.
textureDirection: Flat fills, fine border weight, one hairline chapter rule. No grain, glass stacks, pastel capsules, or gradient meshes.
supportingPageTreatment: Calmer bordered cards and muted section bands after the first chamber. Accent only on interactive affordances. Navigation keeps a minimal border lintel.
